run_swap_test.description: End-to-end test of the icy-swap UI with the throwaway test wallet from 1Password: connect, fill amount and BTC address, approve, optionally swap, and read the result. Signs only ICY/swapper calls and IcySwap EIP-712 data, via cast. Opens and closes its own background tab.

url.description: icy.so or a Worker version preview URL, e.g. https://<ver>-df-treasury-icy-swap.infras.workers.dev/ (default https://icy.so/)

swap.description: true = submit the swap after approve (moves real ICY, pays real sats); false = stop after approve

returns.description: {url, amount, ok, steps: {connected, addressFilled, firstButton, approveTx, buttonAfterApprove, secondsToSwapButton, swapTx, latestSwap}, log}
